svg.text: Deployment: a participant and the dataspace authority
Where the images run, which ports are public, what is mounted, and what crosses the public internet (production layout from DEPLOYING)
Authority's host [its own host and network zone]
8070, public through the proxy: DID document, issuer service, status lists, bundles
8071, internal only: management API, health checks
Issuer key (P-256 PEM), credential definitions, management key, public bundle
DSP requests and callbacks, DID documents, presentation queries
Credential requests; deliveries come back through our proxy
VP-JWT out; it reads our DID document and chain through our proxy [HTTPS]
Calls; the arrow points from the caller

C4 model, deployment diagram. One container per database file; images hold only the binary, the CA bundle and /data. Arrows that leave a host cross the public internet over HTTPS; outbound calls leave the containers directly (keep an egress firewall). The issuer never runs on a participant's host; the bundle key

and the issuer key backup stay offline. The demo in examples/compose runs all of it on one machine over plain HTTP. Health checks: Docker runs each image's HEALTHCHECK (the health subcommand) inside the container; Kubernetes probes /api/check/* on 8081, 8091 or 8071, never through the proxy. Traces
and metrics (OTLP/HTTP) leave only when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set; the issuer sends its own to the authority's backend (not drawn).
